qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the oil pressure switch/oil temperature switch on S14/S50/S38 engines?
What torque value should be used for the oil pressure switch on M60/M62/M73 engines?
What is the torque specification for all other oil pressure switches not specifically listed?
What component is identified by code 1AZ in the oil pressure, oil temperature, oil level display section?
What special note is provided for the oil pressure switch installation?
Which section of the manual does this torque specification table belong to?
What is section 12 61 specifically covering in terms of components?
qa_pairs.answer: Oil pressure, oil temperature, oil level display

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque specifications are listed for oil pressure switches?
qa_pairs.answer: Three different torque specifications: 20 Nm, 27 Nm, and 35 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What unit of measurement is used for all the torque specifications on this page?
Which engine types require the lowest torque specification for the oil pressure switch?
qa_pairs.answer: S14/S50/S38 engines require the lowest torque at 20 Nm
